Run MIMIC-code / eICU-code handcrafted SQL concepts.

Source: R/handcrafted_concepts.R
run_external_concepts.Rd

Executes the adapted SQL scripts in sql_dir (by default the project's concepts_sqls/external/ directory; run_concepts() also uses it for the packaged concepts_sqls/ehr/ layer) in dependency order. Tables are written to {src_name}_coh_derived.

Usage

run_external_concepts(
  con,
  paths,
  schema_names,
  src_name,
  sql_dir = NULL,
  categories = NULL,
  skip_on_error = FALSE,
  execute = TRUE,
  save_adapted = FALSE,
  save_to = NULL,
  target_schema = NULL
)

Arguments

con

DBI connection (search_path will be set via postgres-functions.sql).

paths

List from ehr_paths(). Must include external_sql_dir when sql_dir is not given.

schema_names

List from src_schema_names(). Must include raw and derived.

src_name

Source name used for schema adaptation.

sql_dir

Optional SQL directory. Defaults to paths$external_sql_dir.

categories

Character vector of category subdirs to run. NULL = all. Valid values: "demographics", "measurement", "comorbidity", "medication", "treatment", "firstday", "organfailure", "score", "sepsis".

skip_on_error

If TRUE, log errors and continue; if FALSE, stop on first failure (default FALSE).

execute

If TRUE, execute adapted SQL. If FALSE, only adapt/save SQL.

save_adapted

If TRUE, save adapted SQL files.

save_to

Optional output directory for adapted SQL.

target_schema

Optional schema to write user/external concepts to.

Value

Invisibly returns a named logical vector: TRUE = success per file.

Details

The SQL files were converted from mimic-code for a specific demo schema. When src_name differs from the schema baked into the files, schema names are substituted on-the-fly before execution (demo -> full, or vice versa).

The "comorbidity" and "score" categories (e.g. charlson.sql, elixhauser_*.sql, apsiii.sql, sapsii.sql, and the MIMIC-III sepsis/{angus,explicit,martin}.sql and diagnosis/ccs_dx.sql files) are unmodified, third-party clinical definitions from the public MIT-LCP mimic-code/eicu-code repositories. They are executed unconditionally whenever the source's packaged mimic_code/eicu_code directory exists. This package does not independently re-validate their clinical content (ICD code lists, scoring formulas), consistent with how icdpicr/ icdpicr2 are treated as trusted external dependencies. In particular, charlson.sql/elixhauser_*.sql here are a separate, independently computed comorbidity output from run_comorbidities()'s accepted raw.comorbidities table: they live in a different schema ({src}_coh_derived vs. raw) under different table names and use different underlying logic (community SQL vs. the comorbidity R package). raw.comorbidities is this package's accepted comorbidity output; the tables produced here are a community reference, not a replacement for it.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
con <- connect_postgres("rendehr", load_credentials("config/config_pass.json"))
run_external_concepts(con, paths = ehr_paths("mimic_iv_demo"),
  schema_names = src_schema_names("mimic_iv_demo"), src_name = "mimic_iv_demo")
} # }
